name: TextArea
description: Multi-line text input field for longer user input.

notes: Renders a native textarea, so labels, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, and form validation behave natively
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute and also publishes data-disabled for styling
Keyboard focus is indicated by the shared focus indicator, which tracks the field or the scroll surface when maxHeight is set
The drag-to-resize handle is decorative, aria-hidden, and pointer-only; keyboard users are never required to use it

contract.element: Native textarea inside root/surface wrappers and an optional scroll wrapper
contract.nativeProps: Textarea attributes and events, including id, aria-describedby and onKeyDown, reach the textarea. className and style target the outer root.
contract.state: value is controlled; state.value takes precedence. defaultValue supplies an uncontrolled initial value; onChange receives a native textarea event.
contract.layout: size controls minimum height/density. maxHeight enables an internal scroll surface. Style the field with styles.field and the scroll region with styles.scroll.
contract.composition: For embedded composers, clear surface styles through the documented field/surface/scroll slots, rather than intercepting keyboard events on a wrapper.
contract.accessibility: Use Label htmlFor matching the textarea id. Keyboard shortcuts can be handled directly with onKeyDown; keep ordinary Enter available unless the product explicitly changes it.

examples.name: Textarea keyboard submission
examples.description: Handle Ctrl/Cmd+Enter directly on the native textarea.
